text: Study the characters of the people you have to do with, and know what they are, instead of thinking them what they should be; address yourself generally to the senses, to the heart, and to the weaknesses of mankind, but very rarely to their reason.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CLVIII, to his son, London, February 6, Old Style 1752
